{"initial_observation":{"company":"CLOSE_fin_06","message":"The ledger is accessed through the supplied SQL tools.","storage_note":"Pandas materializes recorded_at as SQLite YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS timestamps. Compare timestamps semantically, for example datetime(recorded_at)<=datetime(cutoff). Raw lexical comparison with a T-separated cutoff changes same-day ordering."},"max_actions":10,"task":"Company CLOSE_fin_06 keeps a single heterogeneous ledger table. Every record type is stored in ledger, so SQL self-joins and CTEs can be used. Close the payable ledger as it was known at recorded_at <= 2026-10-24T12:00:00, for business_date <= 2026-10-23. All timestamps are UTC ISO text. Start by excluding rows with future business dates and rows recorded late, then keep only the highest revision for each (kind,event_key). If that latest row has status void, the key is removed entirely; never fall back to an older row. Invoice rows use event_key as the invoice ID; payment, credit and hold rows use invoice_id to point to their parent invoice. Keep the active invoices for vendor BLUE with due_date <= 2026-10-30. Payments and credits reduce the gross amount_minor, in the invoice currency. Active holds reduce the remaining amount; holds with status release or void do not. Clamp as follows: remaining=max(0,gross-sum(payments)-sum(credits)), then unheld=max(0,remaining-sum(active holds)). For each invoice, pick the active terms row that has the same terms_code and the greatest business_date <= the invoice business_date (applying the same revision and as-of filtering). The discounted amount is unheld * (10000-discount_bps)/10000 only when 2026-10-23 <= discount_until; otherwise it is unheld. Next, pick the active FX row for that invoice's currency with the greatest business_date <= the invoice business_date. Convert to USD cents using fx_num/fx_den. Round only this final per-invoice amount to the nearest cent, rounding exact halves up. Sum the rounded per-invoice USD cents. Invoices in USD also have FX rows. Do not net invoices together before rounding. Submit only the integer number of USD cents.","task_id":"fin-06","tools":[{"description":"Get a list of available table names for a company.","name":"get_descriptions","parameters":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"company_name":{"description":"The name of the company","type":"string"}},"required":["company_name"],"type":"object"}},{"description":"Get table metadata: description, columns, types, unique values.","name":"get_table_info","parameters":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"company_name":{"description":"The name of the company","type":"string"},"table_name":{"description":"The name of the table","type":"string"}},"required":["company_name","table_name"],"type":"object"}},{"description":"Execute a SQL query on a table. Select * not allowed.

Filters are required: WHERE, HAVING, IN, NOT IN, EXISTS, NOT EXISTS,
ANY, SOME, ALL, LIKE, NOT LIKE, BETWEEN, NOT BETWEEN, IS NULL,
IS NOT NULL, CASE, FILTER.","name":"sql_query","parameters":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"company_name":{"description":"The name of the company","type":"string"},"query":{"description":"SQL query to execute (must include filters)","type":"string"},"table_name":{"description":"The name of the table","type":"string"}},"required":["company_name","table_name","query"],"type":"object"}},{"description":"Submit a final answer for the question.","name":"submit_answer","parameters":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"answer":{"description":"The final answer to submit","type":"string"}},"required":["answer"],"type":"object"}}]}

{"tool":"sql_query","arguments":{"company_name":"CLOSE_fin_06","table_name":"ledger","query":"WITH ranked AS (SELECT kind,event_key,invoice_id,vendor,business_date,revision,status,amount_minor,currency,due_date,discount_until,terms_code,discount_bps,fx_num,fx_den,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY kind,event_key ORDER BY revision DESC) AS rn FROM ledger WHERE business_date <= '2026-10-23' AND datetime(recorded_at) <= datetime('2026-10-24T12:00:00')), active AS (SELECT kind,event_key,invoice_id,vendor,business_date,status,amount_minor,currency,due_date,discount_until,terms_code,discount_bps,fx_num,fx_den FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 AND status <> 'void'), balances AS (SELECT i.event_key,i.business_date,i.currency,i.amount_minor,i.discount_until,i.terms_code,COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount_minor) FROM active p WHERE p.kind='payment' AND p.invoice_id=i.event_key),0) AS payments,COALESCE((SELECT SUM(c.amount_minor) FROM active c WHERE c.kind='credit' AND c.invoice_id=i.event_key),0) AS credits,COALESCE((SELECT SUM(h.amount_minor) FROM active h WHERE h.kind='hold' AND h.status='active' AND h.invoice_id=i.event_key),0) AS holds FROM active i WHERE i.kind='invoice' AND i.vendor='BLUE' AND i.due_date <= '2026-10-30'), matched AS (SELECT b.event_key,b.business_date,b.currency,b.amount_minor,b.payments,b.credits,b.holds,b.discount_until,MAX(0,MAX(0,b.amount_minor-b.payments-b.credits)-b.holds) AS unheld,t.event_key AS terms_key,t.discount_bps,f.event_key AS fx_key,f.fx_num,f.fx_den FROM balances b LEFT JOIN active t ON t.kind='terms' AND t.event_key=(SELECT tt.event_key FROM active tt WHERE tt.kind='terms' AND tt.terms_code=b.terms_code AND tt.business_date<=b.business_date ORDER BY tt.business_date DESC LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN active f ON f.kind='fx' AND f.event_key=(SELECT ff.event_key FROM active ff WHERE ff.kind='fx' AND ff.currency=b.currency AND ff.business_date<=b.business_date ORDER BY ff.business_date DESC LIMIT 1)) SELECT event_key,business_date,currency,amount_minor,payments,credits,holds,unheld,discount_until,terms_key,discount_bps,fx_key,fx_num,fx_den FROM matched WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY event_key"}}

item.text: {"tool":"sql_query","arguments":{"company_name":"CLOSE_fin_06","table_name":"ledger","query":"WITH ranked AS (SELECT kind,event_key,invoice_id,vendor,business_date,status,amount_minor,currency,due_date,discount_until,terms_code,discount_bps,fx_num,fx_den,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY kind,event_key ORDER BY revision DESC) AS rn FROM ledger WHERE business_date<='2026-10-23' AND datetime(recorded_at)<=datetime('2026-10-24T12:00:00')), active AS (SELECT kind,event_key,invoice_id,vendor,business_date,status,amount_minor,currency,due_date,discount_until,terms_code,discount_bps,fx_num,fx_den FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 AND status<>'void'), balances AS (SELECT i.event_key,i.business_date,i.currency,i.discount_until,i.terms_code,MAX(0,MAX(0,i.amount_minor-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount_minor) FROM active p WHERE p.kind='payment' AND p.invoice_id=i.event_key),0)-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(c.amount_minor) FROM active c WHERE c.kind='credit' AND c.invoice_id=i.event_key),0))-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(h.amount_minor) FROM active h WHERE h.kind='hold' AND h.status='active' AND h.invoice_id=i.event_key),0)) AS unheld FROM active i WHERE i.kind='invoice' AND i.vendor='BLUE' AND i.due_date<='2026-10-30'), fractions AS (SELECT b.event_key,b.unheld*(CASE WHEN b.discount_until>='2026-10-23' THEN 10000-t.discount_bps ELSE 10000 END)*f.fx_num AS numerator,10000*f.fx_den AS denominator FROM balances b JOIN active t ON t.kind='terms' AND t.event_key=(SELECT tt.event_key FROM active tt WHERE tt.kind='terms' AND tt.terms_code=b.terms_code AND tt.business_date<=b.business_date ORDER BY tt.business_date DESC LIMIT 1) JOIN active f ON f.kind='fx' AND f.event_key=(SELECT ff.event_key FROM active ff WHERE ff.kind='fx' AND ff.currency=b.currency AND ff.business_date<=b.business_date ORDER BY ff.business_date DESC LIMIT 1)), rounded AS (SELECT event_key,CAST(numerator/denominator AS INTEGER)+CASE WHEN 2*(numerator%denominator)>=denominator THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS usd_cents FROM fractions WHERE denominator>0) SELECT event_key,usd_cents,SUM(usd_cents) OVER () AS total_usd_cents FROM rounded WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY event_key"}}
